recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic sepia-toned composition featuring a vertical stack of stylized portraits on the right margin, set against a heavily textured, distressed background with bold, layered typography in the center-left.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment of portraits creates a structural border on the right.
Contrast between dark brown stencil-like text and light cream sans-serif text.
Heavy grain and halftone textures unify the foreground and background elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portraits are stacked vertically on the far right; text is centered horizontally but slightly lower than the vertical midpoint.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark, distressed display text in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold central text, move right to the stacked faces, and then scan the textured background details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and center, filled with subtle geometric ghosting and heavy grain.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre/Tan background providing a warm, aged feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark Umber/Brown for shadows, portraits, and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream/Off-white for secondary text and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark ink and light paper tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy block sans-serif and rounded geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text features irregular, eroded edges suggesting a worn stencil or woodblock print.
Secondary text uses clean, rounded terminals with tight kerning.
Letters in the primary line are slightly varied in baseline and height.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed 'nibbled' edges on all primary glyphs.
Interlocking or touching characters in the secondary line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rugged, dark, uppercase display face and a smooth, light, rounded lowercase-heavy face.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Haettenschweiler with roughened edges
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, compressed weight of the primary display text.
Matches the geometric, soft-terminal feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned, distressed background with heavy film grain and subtle geometric ghosting. On the far right, place a vertical column of four high-contrast, threshold-style male portraits, stacked one above the other.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the center-left. The top line should be large, dark brown, uppercase, and heavily distressed. The second line should be medium-sized, cream-colored, rounded sans-serif, positioned slightly overlapping the bottom of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Are the portraits rendered in a high-contrast, graphic style?
Does the primary text have a rugged, eroded texture?
Is the grain and halftone texture visible across the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the primary text
Number of portraits in the vertical stack
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is illegible due to distress.
Verify the vertical alignment of the portrait strip.
Check that the cream text pops against the sepia background.
Confirm the halftone pattern doesn't obscure facial features.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertical strip of high-contrast threshold portraits with a two-tone distressed typographic lockup on a heavily textured monochromatic sepia field.
